executiveSummary: Iteration 000044 implements the multi-PRD scaffolding with broad compliance. The Zod schema, define-requirement, create-prototype, audit-prototype, and refactor-prototype are fully compliant. Three gaps remain: (1) scaffold template still uses legacy single-object format for array fields; (2) approve-prototype guardrail checks legacy filenames only, blocking multi-PRD flows; (3) approve-prototype PR body hardcodes the legacy refactor report path. A breaking output message change in approve-requirement fails the backward-compat test.
minorObservations: approve-requirement generates a single it_XXXXXX_PRD.json even for multiple PRDs (last-wins). Low-risk since it is only a legacy fallback in create-prototype.
progress.json entries reference audit_artifact_path / refactor_report_path with legacy names; these fields appear unused by core commands.
New confirmation prompt in approve-requirement blocks non-interactive CI runs that previously worked without --force.
approve-prototype guardrail does not read state.phases.prototype.prototype_audit / prototype_refactor for completion status.
conclusionsAndRecommendations: Fix four items: (1) update scaffold/templates to use empty arrays []; (2) extend approve-prototype guardrail to recognise per-PRD audit-report_NNN.json and refactor-plan_NNN.md files (or read from state); (3) update approve-prototype PR body to read refactor paths from state.phases.prototype.prototype_refactor; (4) update US-003-AC08a test to expect the new success message and add --force or stdin 'y' to satisfy the confirmation prompt.

refactorPlan.title: Fix scaffold template (FR-8)
refactorPlan.description: Replace legacy single-object initialisations for requirement_definition, prototype_creation, prototype_audit, and prototype_refactor with empty arrays [].

refactorPlan.title: Fix approve-prototype guardrail to recognise new file names (FR-9)
refactorPlan.description: Extend the hasAuditMd/hasAuditJson/hasRefactorReport check to also pass when state.phases.prototype.prototype_audit is a non-empty all-completed array, and state.phases.prototype.prototype_refactor is a non-empty all-completed array.

refactorPlan.title: Fix approve-prototype PR body refactor path (FR-9 / US-008-AC03)
refactorPlan.description: Replace hardcoded it_XXXXXX_refactor-report.md with paths read from state.phases.prototype.prototype_refactor, falling back to the legacy name only when the array is empty.

refactorPlan.title: Fix backward-compat test US-003-AC08a (US-006)
refactorPlan.description: Update expected stdout to 'All 1 requirement(s) approved.' and add --force to CLI invocation (or pipe 'y' to stdin) so the confirmation prompt does not abort.
